::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 14th [1886]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 149-50:
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)

[Mudie](organizations/other_137.qmd)’s books have come at last, after spending ten days on the road. [Greville](other_books/otherbook_1002.qmd) is there. And the [Queen’s Journals](other_books/otherbook_1009.qmd).[^1]

Shall I return you the latter from the [London Library](organizations/other_29.qmd).

I ought to have the Proofs of [the Quest of Ulysses](cmy_books/cmybook_185.qmd). I know I put Lord Balmerino into the wrong rebellion which is as bad as putting Dunfermline on the wrong side of Scotland as I did in [Unknown to History](cmy_books/cmybook_157.qmd).

So much for not verifying!

There is a horrible misprint in the [Armourers’ prentices](cmy_books/cmybook_171.qmd). Alderman Ityllio.

It is in the two  complete editions, but not in in [sic] the [Magazine](organizations/other_68.qmd). I believe it arose from my trying to change his name in the proof, and not having a revise. I meant it for Hillyard, but I have never yet discovered how to make an H that the printers do not take for It or a z that they do not make into a y[^2]

Yours truly
C M Yonge		

After all Mudie has only sent the second Highland Journal so I must keep the first

---

[^1]: These were books she required for work on *Victorian Half-Century*.
[^2]: CMY’s way of writing a Z is often confusing.
